step1_analysis.description: This circuit forms the active negative resistance core of an LC voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO). The cross-coupled transistors (XM1, XM3) provide the necessary positive feedback (negative resistance) to sustain oscillation, while XM2 acts as the tail current source.

oscillation_frequency.description: Frequency of oscillation determined by the LC tank and parasitic capacitances.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L*C)). With L=2nH (differential) and C=2.2pF, f ~= 2.4 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeting the 2.4 GHz ISM band as specified in the paper for 802.11b/Bluetooth.

voltage_swing_pp.description: Peak-to-peak differential voltage swing across the tank.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_swing ~= (4/pi) * I_tail * R_p. With I_tail=5mA and R_p=200 ohm, V_swing ~= 1.2V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the tank Q and tail current. Should be large enough to drive the next stage (e.g., mixer or prescaler) but is ultimately limited by VDD.

power_consumption.description: DC power consumed by the VCO core.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_tail. I_tail = 0.5 * u_n * C_ox * (W/L) * V_ov^2. Assuming W/L=50/0.15 (scaled up for RF gm requirements) and V_ov=0.33V, I_tail ~= 5mA. P = 1.8V * 5mA = 9mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The VCO typically consumes a fraction of the total transceiver power. The W/L ratios are increased in the testbench to provide sufficient gm for a realistic 2.4GHz tank Q.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure oscillation frequency, voltage swing, and power consumption of the VCO core with an ideal LC tank.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Core Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Scaled up W/L for realistic RF gm at 2.4GHz
.param W_xm1=50u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=50u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=50u L_xm3=0.15u

* DUT
XM1 N1 N2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 N1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Biasing and Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB BIAS 0 0.75

* LC Tank for 2.4 GHz
L1 VDD N1 1n
L2 VDD N2 1n
C1 N1 N2 2.2p
R1 N1 VDD 200
R2 N2 VDD 200

* Kickstart pulse to ensure oscillation starts quickly
Ikick N1 N2 PULSE(0 1m 0 100p 100p 100p 100n)

* Differential voltage dummy source for measurement
B1 VDIFF 0 V=v(N1)-v(N2)

.control
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Measure Oscillation Frequency (measure later cycles to ensure steady state)
  meas tran t1 trig v(VDIFF) val=0 rise=30 targ v(VDIFF) val=0 rise=31
  let freq = 1/t1
  print freq
  
  * Measure Voltage Swing
  meas tran v_max max v(VDIFF) from=10n to=20n
  meas tran v_min min v(VDIFF) from=10n to=20n
  let v_pp = v_max - v_min
  print v_pp
  
  * Measure Power Consumption
  meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD) from=10n to=20n
  let power_tran = -pwr_avg * 1.8
  print power_tran
  
  quit
.endc
.end
